sections.section_name: Section B - Very Short Answer (VSA) / Definitions

questions.question_text: Define the term 'curation' in the context of building a School or Class Museum. [20-30 words]
questions.answer: Curation is the careful process of selecting, organizing, labeling, and displaying objects safely so that they tell a clear educational story to museum visitors.

questions.question_text: List two essential hygiene rules that must be followed before starting any 'Cooking Without Fire' activity. [20-30 words]
questions.answer: Students must wash their hands thoroughly with soap and water, and ensure all raw fruits, vegetables, and utensils are washed cleanly before use.

questions.question_text: What is the function of the 'Costumes' tab in the Scratch programming environment? [20-30 words]
questions.answer: The Costumes tab allows users to change or edit the appearance of a sprite, helping create the illusion of animation when switched rapidly in code.

questions.question_text: You are organizing a Class Museum displaying 'Traditional Toys'. Explain how you will organize the display space, label the toys, and guide visiting students to ensure the items are not damaged. [35-45 words]
questions.answer: I will arrange the toys securely on stable desks, ensuring they are spaced out nicely. Each toy will have a clear label stating its name, material, and origin. I will put up 'Please Do Not Touch' signs and guide visitors in an orderly line.
